title: Subscription-Only Auto Run CEO — AUDIT_R2 corrections: authoritative ChatGPT auth-mode proof for autonomous CEO/Planner/Codex invocations, route-resolved SUBSCRIPTION re-proof in assertAndReserve
description: AUDIT_R2 targeted corrections on the opt-in subscription-only autonomous lane (PAIR_OBJECTIVE_AUTO_DRIVER=1, still default OFF). R2-F1: AUTH_OK+SUBSCRIPTION label is not proof of ChatGPT billing — codex-cli-transport gains codexAuthMode(), a secret-safe structural resolver of the persisted CODEX_HOME/auth.json session: a stored OPENAI_API_KEY resolves API_KEY (metered billing even with env keys absent), a ChatGPT OAuth tokens shape resolves CHATGPT, missing file UNAUTHENTICATED, malformed/contradictory AMBIGUOUS — credential VALUES are never read, logged or persisted. Enforcement: CodexCliExecutorAdapter re-proves CHATGPT at the autonomous spawn boundary → FAIL_CLOSED_CODEX_AUTH_MODE; the driver’s codexSubscriptionAuthProven folds live auth-mode into ceoSubscriptionProven at admission AND inside authorityGate, which the operating loop fires before every external crossing (CEO call, planner call, review commit, allocation, openWorkItem) → mid-pass auth loss denies the next crossing and quarantines DRIVER_SUBSCRIPTION_UNVERIFIED; assertAndReserve re-checks the mode inside the atomic txn → FAIL_CLOSED_COST_AUTONOMOUS_AUTH_MODE. R2-F2: the autonomous CODEX reservation gate validates the SELECTED route’s resolved billing identity (billingFor route→model→executor order) inside the same txn — FREE/UNMETERED/UNKNOWN/METERED_API/unbounded/contradictory bindings denied; COMMITTED/SETTLED adoption and manual dispatch untouched. Evidence: 52 focused tests (Z9.1-11 ChatGPT ok / persisted-key denied / absent denied / ambiguous denied / mid-admission flip denied / route SUBSCRIPTION→FREE denied at reserve / authority_gate mid-pass flip / adapter spawn boundary / manual preserved) failing-first pre-implementation; p15-10c family + phase-c-r1 seed per-stack CODEX_HOME ChatGPT fixtures; win32 baselines unchanged (10d=15, 10d-r1=7, met-fold=7, p15-3=9, cpl1=22, p5=3).
